product.name: 15.6" Laptop Bag

images.alt: Interior view of the 15.6 inch laptop bag

product.description: Padded, water-resistant laptop bag fitting laptops up to 15.6". Dedicated laptop compartment plus pockets for charger, mouse and cables. Adjustable shoulder strap and reinforced carry handles.

faqs.question: Will this fit a 14" or 13" laptop too?
faqs.answer: Yes — this bag comfortably fits any laptop up to 15.6", including smaller 13"–14" models.

faqs.question: Is it padded for protection?
faqs.answer: Yes, the main laptop compartment is padded on all sides.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this bag?
faqs.answer: This bag carries a 3-month warranty against manufacturing defects (zips, straps, stitching).
